topic: what a Friday release checklist really needs

grades.notes:
coverage: five atoms across number, mechanism, limit and object: the 70% outage share, three answers, 5 to 9 items, WHO 19 in 7/7/5, 1.5% to 0.8%
specificity: each atom carries a figure or a named object: 19 items as 7, 7 and 5; 1.5% to 0.8% across 8 hospitals; 5 to 9 items
sourced: every row names a published source with a URL or chapter: SRE book Introduction, Gawande ch. 6, WHO 2009, Haynes NEJM 2009
surprise: a surgical list stops three times with no pause over nine checks; most release lists are one long page before go-live

novelty: one sheet that splits into three cards on camera, no cut in the film; round 12 pieces were still pages of rows and stops
truth: 19 checks in 7, 7 and 5 is the WHO 2009 list; 5 to 9 per pause is Gawande ch. 6; the Friday pauses map to the SRE book's three answers
relevance: a release owner reads a Friday list before go-live; the film shows where its checks belong in time
intrigue: the long sheet at frame 0 is visibly too long for one stop, and the viewer waits to see how it breaks apart
tone: it states counts and sources only, with no advice voice and no selling; the close is the three counts on three cards

coherence: kitchen-rail lends the rail and stamped tickets; one long ticket of 19 checks cut into three tickets of 7, 7 and 5 is the angle itself
feasibility: one 10 s film at 1080x1350 on the dark ground: a canvas rail, three tickets, ticks, a camera glide; the hook in HTML at frame 0

idea: critic: one tall ticket cut into three ticked one pause at a time, 19 = 7 + 7 + 5, reads as checklist tickets
hook: critic: the headline drops "at most" and claims nine over tickets of 7, 7 and 5; surgical and release never on screen
hierarchy: critic: the headline then the tickets read in order; the salmon bracket shares the 19 label and the 9 is unmarked
craft: critic: labels smear in the camera moves and clip at the left edge at 6 s and 7 s; a tone step crosses the long ticket
colour: critic: accent paint 0% at frame 0 and the poster; the plan's accent never reaches the thing to remember
distinct: critic: a rail of hanging tickets that splits on camera departs from the specimen and the three earlier still pieces

idea: critic: only this subject fills the 19-check ticket cut into 7, 7 and 5; the squiggles and no Friday release word weaken it
hook: critic: "Nineteen checks. Nine at most per pause." reads first at phone size, with the ticket header "19 checks"
hierarchy: critic: the headline then the ticket row read in order; the last 3 s hold a small ticked poster over an empty band
craft: critic: the ticket titles are about 28 px drawn, 9 px on a phone; the third ticket overlaps the second mid-drop at 3 s
colour: critic: the counts turn mint at 9 s, an accent step of 0.033 the colour check flags; the coral bracket reads well
distinct: critic: palette, ticks and the 19-to-7/7/5 cut depart from the specimen, though the poster layout sits close to it

idea: critic: the 19-check ticket cut into 7, 7 and 5 is only this subject, but the cut at 3 s is the least readable frame
hook: critic: "Nineteen checks. Nine at most per pause." reads first; the headline names no subject at phone size
hierarchy: critic: headline, then the rail, then the counts read in order; the bracket is gone by the hold
craft: critic: the stamps cover row 4 and its squiggle strikes "7 of 7"; the pieces overlap with a grey bar at 3 s
colour: critic: coral for the 9 then green for the counts follows colour-plan.md; text 12.9:1 and cvd pass
distinct: critic: departs from the three still pieces but keeps the kitchen-rail specimen skeleton of rail, clips and stamps

angle.one_line: One long Friday list splits into three short ones on camera, 19 checks read 7, 7 and 5 at a time, as the surgical checklist does.
